title: "Dear Santa, I'm a size…": the wish list that doesn't come in sizes
summary: Start with "Dear Santa, I'm a size…" and finish with the wish you really want, like a size quiet weekend. AI helps you find the funniest ending.
why: Later's November 2026 Reels roundup (entry dated November 20) and NewEngen's Instagram trends page (updated November 20, 2026) both list "Dear Santa, I'm a size…": creators put the line on screen, then finish it with a wish that can't come in a size, set to a soft instrumental Christmas sound.
steps: Use the main prompt to brainstorm endings that fit your life.
Film 5 to 10 seconds of yourself, your desk or your space looking hopeful.
Put "Dear Santa, I'm a size…" on screen first, then pop in your ending a beat later.
Add a calm holiday sound from the app's library and ask viewers for their own ending in the comments.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: I'm making a short holiday clip that starts with the on-screen line "Dear Santa, I'm a size…" and ends with a wish that can't come in a size, like "a size whole weekend with no plans". Here's a bit about me: [job, hobbies, home life, pets]. Give me 15 endings that sound like me. Keep each under eight words, warm and a little funny, and nothing about body size or weight.

prompts.label: Variation: a whole family or friend group
prompts.text: Give me 8 "Dear Santa, I'm a size…" endings for a group clip where each person holds up their own card. We are [who is in it, e.g. two parents, a teenager and a dog]. Give each person one ending that fits them, short enough to read in two seconds. Keep it kind, with no inside jokes that could embarrass anyone.

prompts.label: Variation: holiday card text overlay
prompts.text: Design a simple festive title card that says "Dear Santa, I'm a size…" in large, friendly hand-lettered type on a soft red and cream background with a few small snowflakes. Leave the bottom third empty so I can add my own ending later. No logos, no characters, no other text.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: our service is the wish
prompts.text: I run [TYPE OF BUSINESS] in [CITY, PROVINCE]. Write 8 "Dear Santa, I'm a size…" endings where the wish is something we really offer, like "a size fresh haircut before the party". Keep it honest: no made-up prices, deals, countdowns or customer quotes. Add one short caption inviting people to share their own wish in the comments.

tips: The pause before the ending is the joke. Give the first line a full second on screen.
Stay away from clothing or body sizes. The fun is that the wish has no size at all.
Business accounts: check the sound is cleared for business use, or use an original sound. The text carries the trend.
Pin your favourite comment ending to keep the thread going.
